summary.text: The black bear is a large wild bear with black fur, one of which Fang Yuan finds during the wolf tide and holds under a Bear Enslavement Gu.

claims.text: Fang Yuan brings a large bear with black fur to Gu Yue Yao Le, a captive tied to a huge rock, and tells her that because of the wolf tide it took him lots of time and effort to find such a wild bear. Gu Yue Yao Le remembers that Fang Yuan once took a Bear Enslavement Gu from Xiong Jiao Man. The bear kills her with a paw strike and starts to eat her, and it would do so even without Fang Yuan’s control of the Bear Enslavement Gu, since it craves food.

An hour later the black bear has almost finished eating Gu Yue Yao Le, but it will not eat her intestines and brain. Fang Yuan activates the Bear Enslavement Gu planted in its body, and under his oppression it swallows the intestines and brain and breaks her bones to bits to swallow them piece by piece. The Man-beast Life Burial Gu’s recipe works best when a wild beast consumes the whole person up to the tiniest scrap, and carnivores such as bears, wolves, and tigers eat the meat easily, while a herbivore has to be forced by its enslavement Gu. Fang Yuan then sends a Single Aperture Charcoal Gu into the bear’s mouth to burn its internal organs, adds three Kerosene Gu that explode into kerosene and intensify the fire, and throws several more Gu worms into its body. The Enslavement Gu keeps the bear from rolling on the ground while it cries out, and in the end sparks come from its eyes, ears, nostrils, and mouth and the fire turns it into a giant fire pillar. When the fire dies on the bear’s corpse, the refinement yields the rank three Man-beast Life Burial Gu, shaped like a black spider with a bear’s head.

Xiong Jiao Man blows a whistle and over two hundred black bears show up, the one at the front of the horde larger than the rest and a hundred beast king level black bear. Her Bear Enslavement Gu rose to rank three during the wolf tide and can finally enslave bear-type hundred beast kings, which makes the horde her trump card. The horde is set against Bai Ning Bing, who wipes out the whole bear group and beheads Xiong Jiao Man with an iceblade.
Bai clan leader offers a green copper relic Gu to Fang Yuan as the reward for hunting an adult black bear.

The bear he meets in the forest is plump and about two metres tall as it stands on two legs, and its clumsy look hides a running speed twice that of ordinary humans. It pounces on Fang Yuan and Bai Ning Bing, but Charred Thunder Potato Gu buried along its path explode every few steps, blasting its chest and crippling its four limbs, and when it retreats a last pit of them ends the fight. Fang Yuan places a torn bear skin before Bai clan leader, who remarks that he killed an adult black bear in a short time.

In the second stage of the dream realm Meng Qiu Zhen enters, a thousand beast king level black bear is his final obstacle, past the man-eating forest, the high fog, and the death marsh. He fights a long and bitter battle with it, and it collapses and shrinks, its blood, flesh, and organs turning into purple poison that flows out of its wounds and orifices. Meng Qiu Zhen had learned from dream butterfly Immortal Gu’s information that it would be the most difficult obstacle. He judges that bee poison Gu, which a bear’s physique restrains, should never be chosen against it, and takes tiger poison Gu as the poison suited to so large a beast. He forms a poison liquid tiger from poison liquid Gu and tiger poison Gu, which fights the bear king head on while he stays at the back helping it with poison path Gu worms, and the battle costs him over half of his primeval essence.
